reasons.claim: 4.07 ha regeneration felling notification (Tierp, Uppsala), status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

Six eligible species (threatened, forest-associated, site-bound fungi/plant with felling-related threats) are recorded within 250 m: Gomphus clavatus (EN, 30 m, 2016), Hydnellum lundellii (EN, 34 m, latest 2021), Hydnellum geogenium (VU, 40 m, 2016), Skeletocutis brevispora (VU, 133 m, 2025), Goodyera repens (VU, 141 m, 2016), Rhodonia placenta (VU, 248 m, 2025).
Six site-bound forest NT species are also recorded within 250 m, for example Hydnellum suaveolens (50 m) and Hermanssonia centrifuga (133 m, 2025). They are supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (1211 records within 1000 m vs county median 113.5). 45 records from 30 species lie within 250 m, across 9 observation days.

uncertainties: Most of the closest records, including the EN ones, date from 2016, so the species may no longer be present or the habitat may have changed. Only some species have 2025 records.
The nearest record is 30 m from the edge and none lie inside the polygon, so the polygon itself may or may not hold these species.
2 records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the felling polygon now.
No records inside the polygon (0 records, no observation days) does not show that the polygon lacks species.
next_action: Have an ecologist review the site promptly. Examine the 2016 and 2025 records for the EN and VU fungi at 30-250 m, and carry out a field check for habitat in and next to the polygon before felling starts.
